evidence: ALD films were grown in a flow-type low-pressure (250 Pa) reactor. TiO2 films were deposited from three different precursor systems employing titanium tetrachloride, TiCl4, and titanium ethoxide, Ti(OC2H5)4, as the metal precursors, while water, H2O, or hydrogen peroxide, H2O2, vapours served as the oxygen precursors. ... Nitrogen was used as the carrier of precursor as well as the purging gas.
